model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates four distinct metrics—training set size, validation set size, and accuracy—for five different identification tasks: 实体识别 (Entity Recognition), 角色识别 (Role Recognition), 异常识别 (Anomaly Recognition), 空间推理 (Spatial Reasoning), and 同义识别 (Synonym Recognition). The horizontal axis lists these five tasks in left-to-right order, while the vertical axis on the left measures quantity in linear scale from 0 to 1200, with tick marks at intervals of 200, and the vertical axis on the right measures accuracy in linear scale from 0 to 1, with tick marks at intervals of 0.1. For each task, there are two bars: a blue bar representing training set size and an orange bar representing validation set size, with their respective numerical values labeled above each bar. The training set sizes are 1102 for Entity Recognition, 1095 for Role Recognition, 1077 for Anomaly Recognition, 1210 for Spatial Reasoning, and 5 for Synonym Recognition. The validation set sizes are 250 for Entity Recognition, 190 for Role Recognition, 40 for Anomaly Recognition, 675 for Spatial Reasoning, and 55 for Synonym Recognition. A gray line with data point labels indicates the accuracy for each task: 0.7666 for Entity Recognition, 0.8714 for Role Recognition, 0.692 for Anomaly Recognition, 0.2852 for Spatial Reasoning, and 0.3769 for Synonym Recognition. The bars are not sorted and are presented in the order of the tasks listed on the horizontal axis.
